decisions.reason: The infectious waste decontamination plant is a flagship co-developed with ERMAFA, sits close to the core WASTX technology, and addresses a regulated, steady demand, so the firm will keep it despite some risk in the partnership and the long sales cycle.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant directly extends the modular, decentralized WASTX line and also serves as a pretreatment stage for the other systems, making it core to the firm's strategy.
